questions.statement: The new superhero movie ________ in several locations across Colombia last year.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This would mean the movie did the filming. We need the passive form.
Correct! Past Simple Passive (was/were + past participle) for a finished action.
Incorrect. This refers to a current or regular action.
Incorrect. This would be used if the specific time wasn't mentioned.

questions.explanation:
Usamos la voz pasiva en el pasado (*was filmed*) cuando queremos resaltar qué se filmó en lugar de quién lo filmó, especialmente si mencionamos un tiempo específico como *last year*.

questions.statement: Millions of songs ________ every day on streaming platforms around the world.
questions.context: Talking about a famous artist's impact.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice in the past.
Incorrect. Active voice in the continuous.
Correct! Present Simple Passive (am/is/are + past participle) for regular actions.
Incorrect. This refers to the past.

questions.explanation:
Para hablar de acciones habituales o hechos generales en voz pasiva, utilizamos el Presente Simple del verbo *to be* más el participio pasado del verbo principal.

questions.statement: The way we see content on social media ________ by complex algorithms recently.
questions.context: Discussing recent changes in social media algorithms.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This is active voice; we need the passive.
Correct! Present Perfect Passive for an action that has happened recently.
Incorrect. Less suitable for "recently" than the Present Perfect.
Incorrect. This refers to an action in progress right now.

questions.explanation:
La voz pasiva en el Presente Perfecto (*has been changed*) se utiliza para acciones que han ocurrido en un tiempo no determinado pero reciente, afectando el estado presente.

questions.statement: The concert ________ because of the heavy rain in Bogotá last night.
questions.context: Explaining why a concert was delayed.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice.
Correct! Past Simple Passive.
Incorrect. Present tense.
Incorrect. "Last night" specifies a finished past time.

questions.explanation:
Cuando el agente de la acción (quien canceló el concierto) no es lo más importante, usamos la voz pasiva para enfocarnos en el evento afectado.

questions.statement: The winners of the music awards ________ next Sunday during a live broadcast.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice.
Correct! Future Simple Passive (will be + past participle).
Incorrect. Active voice.
Incorrect. Grammatically incorrect form.

questions.explanation:
Para eventos futuros donde el foco es lo que sucederá, usamos la pasiva con *will be* seguida del participio pasado.

questions.statement: Before the rise of the internet, news ________ primarily through printed newspapers.

options.feedback: Correct! Past Simple Passive for a past regular situation.
Incorrect. Present Perfect doesn't fit the "before the internet" context.
Incorrect. "News" is an uncountable noun in English and takes a singular verb.
Incorrect. Present tense.

questions.explanation:
Es fundamental recordar que la palabra *news* es incontable y siempre va con el verbo en singular (*was*), incluso en voz pasiva.

questions.statement: Shhh! A new episode of your favorite series ________ in the next room right now.

options.feedback: Incorrect. This refers to a habit.
Correct! Present Continuous Passive (is/are being + past participle) for actions in progress.
Incorrect. Past continuous.
Incorrect. Present perfect.

questions.explanation:
Para acciones que están ocurriendo en este preciso momento en voz pasiva, añadimos la palabra *being* entre el verbo *to be* y el participio pasado.

questions.statement: Which sentence is the most natural to use in a formal movie review?
questions.context: Understanding the use of "by" to indicate the agent.

options.feedback: Incorrect. "People" is too vague as a subject.

options.text: The movie was directed by Steven Spielberg in 1994.
options.feedback: Correct! Formal style often uses passive with "by" for the creator.

options.text: Steven Spielberg directed the movie in 1994.
options.feedback: Incorrect. While correct, B is often preferred in reviews to highlight the movie first.

options.text: The movie directed Steven Spielberg in 1994.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Logically impossible.

questions.explanation:
En críticas formales de arte o cine, es común usar la voz pasiva para poner la obra como sujeto, mencionando al autor con la preposición *by*.

questions.statement: Sensitive personal data ________ on social media to avoid identity theft.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice.
Correct! Passive with modal verbs (modal + be + past participle).
Incorrect. Grammatically incorrect.
Incorrect. Missing "be".

questions.explanation:
Al usar verbos modales en pasiva, la estructura es: *modal + be + participio pasado*. Esto es muy útil para dar consejos o reglas generales.

questions.statement:
Identify the error in this paragraph:
"The script **was written** (A) by a young author. Later, it **was being sent** (B) to the producers, who loved it. Now, the film **is being produced** (C) in Hollywood and it **will be released** (D) next year."
questions.context: Finding an error in a technical text about media.

options.feedback: Incorrect. Correct use of Past Simple Passive.
Incorrect. This implies a continuous action in the past; it should be Past Simple Passive (*was sent*) for a single completed action.
Incorrect. Correct use of Present Continuous Passive.
Incorrect. Correct use of Future Simple Passive.

questions.explanation:
A nivel B2, el estudiante debe distinguir entre un proceso continuo en el pasado (*was being sent*) y un evento puntual (*was sent*). Enviar un guion es habitualmente una acción puntual.

questions.statement: Which headline is more appropriate for a serious news report about a cybersecurity breach?
questions.context: Choosing between active and passive for impact.

options.text: Someone stole the passwords of 5,000 users!
options.feedback: Incorrect. "Someone" is too informal and vague for news.

options.text: Passwords of 5,000 users have been stolen in a cyberattack.
options.feedback: Correct! Passive voice focuses on the victims and the serious event.

options.text: A hacker was stealing passwords yesterday.
options.feedback: Incorrect. Focuses on the hacker, which might be unknown.
Incorrect. This makes the users the actors, which is not the case.

questions.explanation:
En el periodismo, la voz pasiva es fundamental para reportar hechos donde el perpetrador es desconocido o donde el impacto en las víctimas es lo más relevante.

Complete the sentence:
"In the past, information ________ by a few, but today, content ________ by everyone."

options.feedback: Incorrect. Active voice in the second part.
Correct! Passive voice in both parts, reflecting the shift in power.
Incorrect. Tenses are inverted.
Incorrect. First part refers to a finished past era.

questions.explanation: Este ejercicio requiere evaluar el cambio histórico en los medios: de un control centralizado en el pasado (*was controlled*) a una creación masiva y actual (*is being created*).
